caption: The video captures a tranquil alpine landscape that stays largely still across the excerpt. A broad, snow-streaked mountain peak rises in the background, its flanks partly veiled by low-hanging cloud. A dense treeline of dark evergreens spans the midground, with one tall, bare-topped conifer standing slightly forward of the rest. In the foreground, a glassy lake mirrors the trees and the pale sky, its surface carrying only faint ripples. A soft pinkish light leak washes across the left edge of the frame, adding a hazy glow over the mountain's shoulder. The composition remains fixed with no camera movement, while the high clouds drift slowly and the water shimmers subtly; the evergreens themselves hold their positions. The scene persists as a quiet, near-static vista from first frame to last.
